COSMA.text:
Cosma is a display <tag>typeface</tag> in development since <tag>2024</tag>. It builds on the techno-futurist idiom of late-70s/early-80s electronics and computing—panel labels, interface lettering, early corporate wordmarks—shaped into a flexible, modular system.
Cosma extends these models through three variable axes—Weight, Width, and Contrast. It reaches from Light to Extra Bold, compact to wide, and low to high contrast, holding the construction steady while staying expressive. <tag>Work in progress</tag>.
